questions:
1. **Scope.** The issue asks for larger font size presets ("2xl .. 10xl"); the author's follow-up says corner resizing already makes text big, and asks how to give two big texts the same size. What is in scope: (a) new larger presets in the "Font size" control, (b) no product change, only coverage of the existing ways to get equal large text, or (c) both? *Suggested: (c) new presets, plus regression coverage of the existing ways (multi-select + preset, the "F" field in the "Properties" panel, paste styles).*
2. **Preset names and values.** Which new presets, with which labels and sizes? The current ones are Small 16, Medium 20, Large 28, Very large 36. *Suggested: keep the four, add three: "2XL" = 48, "3XL" = 64, "4XL" = 96 — not nine presets up to "10xl".*
3. **Layout.** Where do the extra presets appear: in the same row of buttons, or in an overflow/dropdown? How on small screens and touch (mobile properties panel)? *Suggested: same row on desktop; on small screens the row wraps or scrolls, every preset reachable, nothing clipped.*
4. **Tooltips and shortcuts.** Do the new presets get tooltips and keyboard shortcuts? *Suggested: tooltips with the label name, no new shortcuts.*
5. **Upper limit.** Is there a maximum font size for the presets, the "F" field, Ctrl+Shift+> and corner resizing? *Suggested: no new limit is introduced; the largest preset is the largest preset size, larger sizes stay reachable via the "F" field, shortcuts and resizing as today.*
6. **Highlighting.** When a text's size equals a new preset value (e.g. typed 64 in "F", or reached by Ctrl+Shift+>), is that preset highlighted? When it matches none, is nothing highlighted? *Suggested: yes to both.*
7. **Mixed selection.** Several texts with different sizes selected: what does the control show, and what does clicking a new preset do? *Suggested: no preset highlighted; one click sets that size on all selected texts — this is also the answer to the author's "two big texts with the same size".*
8. **Text in containers.** Are the new presets available for text in a shape, an arrow label and a sticky note? *Suggested: yes; text in a shape wraps and the shape grows taller; an arrow label stays at the middle; a sticky note keeps auto-fit (shown smaller when it does not fit, never larger than picked).*
9. **Default for new text.** Does a new preset become the default for new text like the existing ones? *Suggested: yes, the last chosen size is the default.*
10. **Existing drawings and older versions.** Existing text keeps its size; an older Excalidraw version opening a file with text at a new preset size shows it at that size with no preset highlighted, without error. *Suggested: yes.*
11. **Interface language.** New labels translated in all locales; a missing translation falls back to English; long labels and right-to-left layout do not break the control. *Suggested: yes; test with German and Arabic (verify which locales have translations).*

answers:
Answers from the product owner, as given by the user. Lines marked "(accepted suggestion)" are suggested answers the user accepted for points the product owner's answers do not cover.

1. **Scope.** The product change is more presets only; there is no typed size field in the "Font size" control. (user) The existing ways to give several texts the same large size (multi-select + preset, the "F" field in the "Properties" panel, paste styles) are covered as regression. (accepted suggestion)
2. **Presets.** Two new presets after "Very large": "Huge" = 56 and "Giant" = 96. The existing four keep their labels and sizes (Small 16, Medium 20, Large 28, Very large 36). (user)
3. **Layout.** On desktop the new presets are in the same row as the existing ones. (accepted suggestion) All six presets fit the 375 px mobile panel. (user) Platforms: latest Chrome, Firefox and Safari on desktop, plus Safari on iOS. (user)
4. **Tooltips and shortcuts.** Tooltips "Huge" and "Giant"; no new shortcuts; the increase and decrease shortcuts (Ctrl+Shift+> and Ctrl+Shift+<) are unchanged. (user)
5. **Upper limit.** The increase and decrease shortcuts have no upper limit. (user) No new limit is introduced for the "F" field or corner resizing either; sizes above 96 stay reachable as today. (accepted suggestion)
6. **Highlighting.** A size between presets highlights no preset until one is clicked. A text at exactly 56 or 96, however it got there, shows its preset highlighted. (user)
7. **Mixed selection.** A selection with mixed sizes highlights no preset until one is clicked; clicking a preset sets that exact size on every selected text. (user)
8. **Text in containers.** Text in shapes wraps and the shape grows taller; arrow labels stay at the middle; sticky note labels offer both presets and keep auto-fit, with the picked preset highlighted. (user)
9. **Default for new text.** The last chosen preset, including "Huge" or "Giant", becomes the default size for new text. (accepted suggestion)
10. **Existing drawings and older versions.** Existing text keeps its size. (accepted suggestion) Older Excalidraw versions are out of scope. (user)
11. **Interface language.** The new labels are translated in every locale; a missing translation falls back to English; long labels and the right-to-left layout do not break the control; tested with German and Arabic. (accepted suggestion)
12. **Copies, history and leaving the session.** Copy and paste styles, copies and undo/redo carry the new sizes; reload, saved file, PNG and SVG export and live collaboration keep them. (user)
